saw: The harness has no notion of infrastructure health: the yield wait polls only its predicate, stop.flag and wall budget; no verification command touches the lab; every watcher reads pids, counts and mtimes.
detection_signal: any read-only lab check between passes; first wedge 2026-10-13 ~01:30
harness_improvement: Harness-run, read-only environment_health command declared in the launch contract: before each pass, at yield arm, every Nth yield poll, before verification; failures reported to the next pass and not charged to yield or attempt budgets.

saw: chain7 recorded and replayed proofs for 90 min while leaf01 bgp.service was systemd-failed (start limit) since 21:03:51; step R3-6 took 59 min vs 35 s for its twin and returned rc=0.
detection_signal: systemctl is-failed bgp from 21:03:51; step duration ratio
cost: 90 min of the last yield; one suspect stored proof
harness_improvement: proof.sh --precondition that refuses to record when a health command fails; per-step timeouts derived from prior durations.

saw: Lab scripts restart bgp (docker restart bgp in spike-env.sh and underlay-apply.sh; stop/start in vrf_wedge_cure) often enough to exceed StartLimitBurst=3/20min; bgp NRestarts 4/9/11/11 on a 6h-old deploy.
harness_improvement: One bounded restart helper: skip when Established, reset-failed first, restart via systemd, refuse past 2 restarts in 20 min.
confidence: verified call sites and journal; sufficiency inferred

saw: Proposer blamed force-resync of unchanged rows for the 'orchagent wedge'; swss.rec shows VRF_TABLE:Vrf1 SET then DEL 1 s later with orchagent consuming both, and wedges 4-6 followed the fix.
harness_improvement: Failure ledger normalises signatures and tells the next pass 'recurred N times since the fix you recorded'.
confidence: swss.rec pattern verified; the owner's race explanation was later refuted (see O-12)

saw: 4 yields per attempt per run and a proposer-guessed deadline; run 20261013-120241 was on yield 4/4 with 14400 s for work that could not fit; the 2026-10-12 run died this way (state=failed exit=22 child-exit=4) with the job left running and no relaunch.
detection_signal: yield_index at cap; remaining steps x measured durations vs deadline at arm time
cost: a dead run on 2026-10-12; avoided on 2026-10-13 only by an outside clean stop and relaunch
harness_improvement: Show remaining yield budget in the pass prompt; flag infeasible deadlines at arm time; budget-spent-with-live-job is a resumable stop; refund yields that ended for an environment reason.

saw: A file_exists yield whose job dies waits until the deadline; only a pid yield resumes on job exit.
detection_signal: adopted pid gone while predicate unsatisfied
cost: up to a full deadline per occurrence
harness_improvement: Yield wait always also watches the adopted pid and resumes with job_rc=dead.

saw: Owner appended a directive to PROGRESS.md, stopped the run cleanly, terminated chain7 and relaunched; in its first pass the proposer healed leaf01 bgp within 13 min (all infra alarms clear 22:49) and began the script fix.
harness_improvement: A first-class operator-note channel that the harness injects at the top of the next pass prompt, instead of relying on the proposer re-reading a 100 KB notes file.

saw: glm-5.3-flash, asked headless for 'the output of the shell command: date +%T' without being told to run it, answered 23:14:07 at 22:38; told to run it, it returned the true value.
cost: unbacked 'verified inline (unrecorded)' claims in PROGRESS.md cannot be trusted
harness_improvement: Critic and verification treat unrecorded health claims as absent; harness-run health check replaces them.

saw: Phases 4 and 6-11 declare executable 'bash' with args ['bash','-c',...]; 'bash bash -c' returned 126 in isolation.
cost: every later gate would reject by construction
harness_improvement: Lint verification commands at contract derivation: executable must not repeat as args[0]; dry-run each command once.
confidence: inferred; not run through the plan runner

saw: Within one pass and zero yields the proposer healed leaf01 bgp, replaced three docker-restart call sites with a budgeted systemd helper, and launched chain8 with a read-only probe gate before every step, per-step timeouts, one bounded cure and lab_sick on second failure.
harness_improvement: Supply the proposer with verified environment facts, its remaining budget and a callable read-only health command; these changed behaviour without a stronger model.
confidence: verified; directive step 3 (race test) not yet confirmed

saw: Pass 1 wrote its yield under the previous run's file name; the harness logged nothing and started pass 2 with a model session open beside the chain; pass 2 wrote the correct file.
detection_signal: new file under yield/ that is not the expected artifact at pass end
cost: one extra pass; model session concurrent with a lab-owning chain
harness_improvement: Pass the exact yield path in the pass prompt/env; emit yield_invalid for any other new file in yield/.

saw: The owner's delete-then-re-add race hypothesis, given as a hypothesis to test, was contradicted by the proposer's experiment (SET then DEL 1 s later reproduces on a bare whole-table /VRF add after a fully consumed delete); nothing was built on it. O-4's race explanation is withdrawn.
cost: none; a no-op guard was avoided
harness_improvement: Operator notes should label hypotheses and require a test before a fix is built on them.
confidence: proposer's experiment file exists; not re-run by the owner

saw: The owner's probe flagged a sick lab on BGP session counts alone while chain8 replayed evpn3, a step that rebuilds the underlay; units active, restart counters flat, no wedge.
harness_improvement: Environment-health contract with two levels: invariants that must hold always, and conditions that must hold between steps.

saw: The owner's probe expected as-built BGP session counts in every state; after seed-restore the fabric was in the documented, deliberately partial factory seed (3/2/1/4 Established), the gate failed, and chain8 exited lab-sick on a healthy lab one receipt short.
detection_signal: fabric matched the seed signature documented in scripts/spike/seed-restore.sh
cost: one receipt not run, one unneeded bgp restart, one resume pass on a false lab-sick; caught 4 minutes after the chain ended
harness_improvement: Health contract declared per expected state; validate a new health check against every legitimate workflow state before it may stop work.

saw: chain9 rebuilt seed to as-built, its canary hit APPLY-STUCK on leaf01 (VRF in CONFIG_DB, absent from APPL_DB and kernel, units active), and the chain exited lab-sick in 15 minutes having recorded nothing; the same fault under earlier chains produced hours of garbage.
detection_signal: canary after rebuild plus read-only gate
harness_improvement: Canary after every environment rebuild and before any evidence step; root cause of the VRF withdrawal remains open.
confidence: sequence verified; 'first VRF add after rebuild' pattern inferred from four samples

saw: Critic listed 67 NEEDS-GROUNDING paths for proofs that exist on disk but were not cited by path; the diagnostician told the proposer to re-record all of them (T044-T108) and claimed existing scripts were not found; an accelerator pass started on that hint. An owner note 18 s into the pass averted it: nothing was re-recorded.
detection_signal: test -f on each NEEDS-GROUNDING path; absence of a grounding_gap event
cost: none this time; plausible cost days plus four clean receipts and a destructive factory clean
harness_improvement: Feedback must separate 'absent on disk' from 'exists but not cited'; diagnostician must verify existence; accelerator must not re-record existing proofs without a named content defect.

saw: Phase 3 attempt 3 rejected on T061-T064 only: stored proofs spike-underlay-v6-<node>.out have an empty 'fabric-link v6 addresses' section because underlay-node.sh pipes one-line `ip -6 -br addr` output through `grep -v fe80`, dropping the global address with the link-local one; `|| true` hides it and the proof exits 0. Live read-back shows the /127 addresses are configured. The hollow proof was recorded 12 Oct, replayed clean and cited through two gate attempts.
detection_signal: section header in a proof .out immediately followed by the next header; grounding slice says '<no decisive lines matched>'
cost: one gate attempt (~2.4 h) plus a re-record; the defect sat unnoticed for ~40 h
harness_improvement: proof.sh fails a recording with an empty section; no `|| true` after filters in proof bodies; replay cleanliness is not treated as content validity.

saw: Phase 3: attempt 2 rejected T082/T089 (recipe doc), attempt 3 rejected only T061-T064, attempt 4 rejected T056-T060, T081, T082, T101, T116. The docs were unmodified since 12 Oct and the v4 underlay slice was unchanged between attempts 3 and 4, so the same defects were present throughout; the critic reported a different subset each time. Proposer and owner both read the shorter list as acceptance of the rest.
detection_signal: criterion rejected in attempt N, absent from attempt N+1's list while its cited files' mtimes are older than attempt N, present again in N+2
cost: one extra attempt per subset (20 min - 2.5 h each); at least two attempts here
harness_improvement: Unresolved criteria carry forward until explicitly marked met; critic emits a per-criterion met/unmet/not-examined table; small proof outputs grounded whole.
